title: pm-dispatch: Tier S PR landed from a project needs a contract-review record by another account; triage shrinks to bare cards in the director project; decision cards stay in their repo, the director scans every repo (maintainer's word 2026-10-23)
body:
Ruled: 6369035432 · batch #7 item 2 · letter A · 2026-10-23T15:55:37Z (interim landing rule while no other account is seated = the maintainer's own words in the executing thread, either naming each PR number or a standing authorization for that seat, Tier S only, per seat, revocable by one sentence; items 1 and 3–6 unaffected; PR #25422 lands after the one-line wording change under the maintainer's 14:14:50Z authorization)

Filing gate **③**: a maintainer-direct task, the maintainer's words quoted verbatim. Filed from the Claude Code project "Objectstack" (account `os-elon-musk`) by the research thread 车队机制迁往 Projects on the maintainer's word there. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane self-applied under exception 二; grade suggested p2; triage may regrade.

**Reader (who acts):** the `domain:skills` seat 2 (seat post #19287), in one PR on `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` (Tier S) plus ratchet ceiling rows. Card thread at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. Sibling of the project-forms card filed in the same stroke; land this one second if SKILL.md line budget forces an order.
## The maintainer's words (2026-10-23, project thread 车队机制迁往 Projects, verbatim)

> 我的账户清单不固定的， 20x 周流量用完了，我就会换另外一个账户。 (06:27Z)
> 具体的分配应该是我人工制定的。 (06:27Z)
> 元数据项目应该各自分诊，但是决裁可以统一报总监。 (06:32Z)
> 管理者不是 bill 是 hotlong / 或者你不要强调是谁 (11:45Z, 11:46Z)
> 全项目并发上限 6 (11:46Z)
> 分诊不忙不如留给总监管 (12:08Z)
> 如果我同意这一整套机制，相关的 skills 是不是都要修改，文件应该落在仓库中 (12:10Z)
> 你立卡并派发处理所有相关任务，跟踪落地 (12:13Z)

> 为什么我们需要区分项目类型？任何一个项目中都可以召唤总监啊，任何一个项目中也可以召唤分诊 (12:25Z — **amendment**: there is ONE project form; 总监席 and 分诊席 are seats like any other, summoned by the maintainer's sentence in whichever project he names. The only invariant is on the account, already in the protocol: 「批准账号永不跑席位」.)

The research memo these cards implement: https://claude.ai/artifact/VFTHWcmKkzbah17UM8KRqm (sections 6, 10–13; private to the maintainer's account).

## What was measured (2026-10-23)

- **Landing.** Three seats on this account ran the same relay call (`dispatch.mjs` `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`) after the maintainer said 「可以落地」 at 06:04Z. Relayed words and a decision-card tap were refused (`[Self-Approval]`); his bare words passed only the PRs the seat's latest ask had named by number (hotcrm 4/4, devx 1/8); his message naming each PR (「#25348 #25254 #25386 可以落地」, 06:16Z) passed all three, two of them under `.claude/**`. Repo and surface are not variables; the classifier binds the user's own authorization to named objects. This is a cost of one human sentence per PR, forever, as long as implementer, reviewer, seat and PR share one account.
- **The protocol already has the fix** and this project simply did not meet it: the independence pair `Implemented-by:` / `Reviewed-by:` (`contract-review.md` 独立性对). Sample: PR #25363 was built by an `os-bill` seat, reviewed by this account's project (record 6357150459, `Reviewed-by:` this session), and one minute later Bill's seat ran `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the relay with no human sentence (ACCEPT 6357165210 says so); merged 04:46Z.
- **Triage.** `triage-duties.md` is 120 lines of hourly duties; the two multi-lane repos see single digits to low tens of bare cards a day. Single-lane repos already self-triage (`cross-repo-coordination.md` 机械三务). Issue events cannot wake a thread, so triage is the one duty that must poll.
- **Decision inbox.** `cross-repo-coordination.md` says 「决策收件箱按仓:平台在 objectstack / objectui,元数据项目在本仓」; in practice hotcrm#2194 was ruled through the director batch (#25344's director lane) and the maintainer wants that to be the rule.
- **Landing, measured later the same day (batch #7 item 2 basis):** the maintainer's own standing sentence in the executing seat thread (14:14:50Z 「后续按 pm-dispatch 规则审核通过的都可以落地」) passed the self-approval check for #25427 (seat report 15:18Z); the HotCRM seat landed three PRs on the same sentence from 13:14Z. Relayed and batch-level authorizations still fail; the maintainer's own words in the executing thread pass, named or standing.

## Wanted

1. **`contract-review.md`, 独立性对:** when the landing seat is a project thread (`mode:thread`), a Tier S PR's review of record must carry a `Reviewed-by:` session that belongs to a **different account** from the PR's author (account read from the PR body's attribution `github_login` line and the relay sender; the record's independence paragraph states both). A same-account isolated subagent is still a review, ⛔ not the review of record for landing. Prose-face PRs (`content/docs/**`, `.changeset`, release text) that owe no contract review get the same cross-account record at `TIER_DEFAULT` (one comment), because the classifier makes no exception for prose.
2. **`landing-operations.md` 落地前检两条:** ① becomes 「达档复核 PASS 在案，且 `Reviewed-by:` 属另一账户（项目形态）」; a `pm:mailbox` PR owes no CI and is never enqueued; ~~the interim rule while no other account is seated: the maintainer's own message in the executing thread naming each PR number.~~ **Ruled A (batch #7 item 2, 6369035432):** the interim rule while no other account is seated: the maintainer's own words in the executing thread, **either** naming each PR number **or** a standing authorization for that seat (Tier S only, per seat, revocable by one sentence); it lapses once another account's review of record is available. Suggested line: 「过渡:无另一账户在席时,① 的替代 = 维护者本人在执行线程的话:逐个点名 PR 编号,或对该席位的 Tier S 长期授权(一句可撤)。」
3. **`dispatch-runbook.md` patrol:** every project's patrol also runs `is:pr is:open label:needs:contract-review`, drops PRs whose attribution login is this account's, leaves a `Claim:`-shaped comment before reviewing (no double work), reviews per `contract-review.md`, removes the marker in the same stroke on PASS. The 总监席's digest lists PRs waiting > 24 h.
4. **Triage shrinks (amended 12:25Z: it stays a seat, summoned in whichever project the maintainer names; by default alongside the 总监席).** `lanes/triage.md` + `triage-duties.md`: the 分诊席 writes labels and audit comments only, no PRs, so no self-approval; its duty is bare cards (no `pm:*`, no `domain:*`, no `needs-user-decision`) first-touch grading and routing, plus cross-lane dedupe / `duplicate_of`, in objectstack and objectui only; half-labelled cards are completed by the owning lane seat; seat-filed cards are born with all three per the filing gate; app repos have no triage seat. The hourly run may share one routine with the 总监席's decision-inbox scan when both sit in one project. Daily duties (release board, pin chain, liveness re-check, fork-PR sweep) move to the 总监席's digest and the lane patrols; name where each goes.
5. **Decision inbox.** `cross-repo-coordination.md`: 「决策收件箱按仓」→「决策卡留在立卡的仓；总监席扫全部仓的 `needs-user-decision`，按批呈维护者」; `lanes/director.md` gains that scan, the thin triage, the digest and the roster. The pin chain (`triage-duties.md` 跨仓 pin 链) extends from objectui/cloud to every app repo (hotcrm#2230 waiting on 18.1.0 is the live case). The new-repo checklist gains: add to `GOVERNED_REPOS`, install the fleet app, write `lanes/<repo>.md`.
6. **Naming:** 「车道账户」 / 「总监账户」 by role; ⛔ no login in rule text.

## Acceptance

- The six files above carry the text; `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` green with ceilings lowered where files shrank (`triage-duties.md` is expected to shrink); `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-frame-freshness` green.
- `git grep -n '决策收件箱按仓' -- .claude/skills` returns nothing.
- A `## Contract review` record template run (`record-recognisers.mjs --template`) shows where the account line goes; the queue-guard check itself is a devx S card filed in the same stroke.
- Tier S landing of this PR follows the rule it writes: a review of record by another account's session, then the owning seat lands; fallback ~~the maintainer's 「#N 可以落地」~~ the maintainer's own words in the executing thread per the ruled item 2 (the 14:14:50Z standing authorization in the Skills seat thread covers #25422).

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, "contract review independence reviewer different account self-approval landing precondition Tier S cross-account Reviewed-by" → 21 hits; top: #23578 (closed, mixed-diff tier), #23426, #21187 (closed, narrowed prose faces — this card re-adds a one-comment cross record for prose, for the classifier, not for the contract), #19133 (closed, Tier S lands on the seat's PASS — this card adds whose PASS), #18382 (closed, self-review predicate), #25344 (closed, revoked autonomous adjudication), #23692, #17285, #16905, #23352. A second search "triage seat thin bare cards only director decision inbox cross repo needs-user-decision app repos self triage pin bump chain hotcrm" → 34 hits; top: #25342, #25321, #21467, #20791, #19931 (closed, hotcrm allow-list), #15936, #24686 (closed, single-lane qualifier), #24589, #24517, #23733 (closed, self-labelled cards accepted by lanes — this card keeps that). None thins triage to bare cards or makes the reviewer's account a landing condition. **New.**

Dedupe words: `Reviewed-by another account landing precondition` · `thin triage 分诊席 labels only` · `decision inbox 总监扫全仓` · `pin chain app repos`.
